We’re building the fastest SEO/GEO-first CMS in the market 🚀 … and we need a Sr. Product Manager (CMS) in Bangalore with 10+ years of product management experience to help us scale.

Your superpower? Turning ideas into strategy, frictions into features, and presentations into customer wins.

🎯 Top 5 Skills You’ll Bring:
- B2B SaaS Product Management (end-to-end ownership)
- CMS & Digital Experience expertise
- Roadmap + Backlog leadership
- Stakeholder & C-Suite communication
- Data-driven decision making (adoption, engagement, retention metrics)

If this sounds like your sprint goals (and you don’t mind being the “voice of the customer” in every meeting 😉) — we’d love to talk.

📩 Interested? DM or share your resume directly with devansh.s@milestoneinternet.com
